statement: CREATE (n:Recipe) RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MERGE (n:Recipe {recipe_id:'x'}) RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) DELETE n RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) DETACH DELETE n RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) SET n.name='x' RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) REMOVE n.name RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
DROP CONSTRAINT recipe_id RETURN 'x' AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
LOAD CSV FROM 'file:///x.csv' AS row RETURN row.id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
CALL db.labels() YIELD label RETURN label AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) FOREACH (x IN [1] | SET n.x=x) RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id; MATCH (m) RETURN m LIMIT 1
MATCH (n:Recipe) RETURN n.recipe_id AS recipe_id LIMIT 1000
